app.title: Video/Audio Automatic Subtitle Generator (NeMo ASR)
app.description: Upload video or audio files to automatically generate  subtitles. Supports multiple NVIDIA NeMo ASR models.

model.cloud_model_info: Different models support different languages and scenarios

ui.tips_content:
- Local  files are saved in the `subtitles` folder in the script directory
- Processing speed depends on your hardware (GPU/CPU) and file size
ui.warning_cpu: **Warning: Currently running on CPU, which will be very slow. It is recommended to use a CUDA GPU for better performance.**
ui.info_gpu_available: **Tip: CUDA GPU detected. Will attempt to run on GPU after selecting a model.**
ui.warning_no_gpu: **Warning: CUDA GPU not detected. Will run on CPU after selecting a model, which may be slower.**

output.word_level_info: Contains timestamp info for every character/word. Suitable for precise synchronization.
output.max_width_info: Forces a line break if exceeded. Applies to standard subtitles only; affects neither Char nor Word level output.

diarization.enable_info: If enabled, the system will attempt to identify different speakers in the audio.
diarization.development_msg: Speaker Diarization is currently under development. Stay tuned!

editing.tips: *Tip: Click '+' below the table to add rows. Select content and press Delete to remove. Changes save automatically.*
editing.save_success_info: Correction dictionary saved to local successfully!
editing.development_msg: Subtitle Editing is currently under development. Stay tuned!

llm.concurrency_info: Number of parallel tasks. Higher is faster.

translation.chunk_size_info: Larger is cheaper & better context, but may cause misalignment or slower speed. Suggested: 30-50
translation.development_msg: LLM Translation is currently under development. Stay tuned!

segmentation.description: **Function**: Re-groups fragmented 'word-level' subtitles (e.g., Char-level SRT) into readable long sentences using LLMs.
segmentation.chunk_info: Larger is cheaper & better context, but might cause misalignment. Suggested 30-50. For char/word srt, set higher.
